name: AARAV MEHTA
headline: Senior Instructional Designer
tagline: 9+ years in corporate eLearning | Storyline 360 & Rise 360 | SCORM & LMS | WCAG 2.1
summary: Instructional designer with 9+ years building corporate eLearning from needs analysis to LMS launch, using ADDIE and SAM and building in Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise 360.
Led a team of 6 designers on compliance and product-training programmes, owning storyboard reviews, QC and the team's templates.
Works closely with SMEs and stakeholders, and uses generative AI for script drafts, storyboards and course visuals.
ai_bullets: Rebuilt a 40-module compliance curriculum in Rise 360 for mobile learners.
Introduced an AI-assisted storyboard workflow that the whole team adopted.

bullets: Lead a team of 6 instructional designers on compliance and product-training programmes for enterprise clients.
Design course architecture, objectives and assessments mapped to Bloom's Taxonomy.
Build interactive courses and simulations in Storyline 360 and Rise 360 to WCAG 2.1 guidelines.
Package courses as SCORM and work with client LMS admins on setup and completion tracking.
Converted operations procedures into role-based eLearning and job aids.
Wrote video scripts and produced screen-capture tutorials in Camtasia.
Ran SME interviews and review rounds to validate accuracy.
